name: common
brief:
Core ADOL-C type definitions and platform configuration

Provides fundamental type definitions (locint, revreal), platform
detection, memory allocation wrappers, and C/C++ interoperability
macros used throughout ADOL-C.

**Key Macros:**
- BEGIN_C_DECLS/END_C_DECLS: extern "C" wrappers
- MAXDEC/MINDEC: Safe max/min update macros
- ADOLC_MATH_NSP: Math function namespace
